title: coppensia ramosa
intro: Coppensia ramosa, commonly known as the "tree of heaven," is a type of deciduous tree native to East Asia. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion and relieve pain, due to its therapeutic actions as an anti-inflammatory and analgesic agent. The bioactive constituents of Coppensia ramosa include lignans, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Additionally, the plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat a variety of ailments, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues.
